description: Defines a template class RangeType for representing and manipulating numeric ranges with inclusive/exclusive bounds, including methods for validation, range calculation, and range checking.

classes.name: RangeType
classes.description: A template class representing a numeric range with configurable inclusive/exclusive bounds, providing methods for validation, range calculation, and range checking.

methods.name: RangeType()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing min and max to default values.

methods.name: RangeType(const TYPE& min, const TYPE& max)
methods.description: Constructor initializing min and max to specified values.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator to copy range values.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison between two RangeType objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison between two RangeType objects.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the range is valid (min <= max).

methods.name: Range()
methods.description: Calculates the size of the range considering inclusive/exclusive bounds.

methods.name: Minimum()
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the range.

methods.name: Maximum()
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the range.

methods.name: InRange(const TYPE& RHS)
methods.description: Checks if a value is within the range considering inclusive/exclusive bounds.
